        , "quality": "advanced vocabulary choice", "description": "Measures the writer's use of elevated, precise, and academic word choices instead of basic conversational phrasing."}, {"evidence": "structured essay organization with clear transition signals (\"My initial reason\", \"In additon\", \"Again\", \"For instance\") and formal letter framing", "quality": "structural organization", "description": "Reflects how effectively the essay uses transitions and structural frameworks to guide the reader through distinct points."}, {"evidence": "anticipation and address of opposing viewpoints (\"I know that my opponents would argue...\")", "quality": "counterargument integration", "description": "Demonstrates the capacity to acknowledge and respond to prospective opposing perspectives within persuasive writing."}, {"evidence": "incorporation of personal observation and a relevant quote (\"if you have lemons make lemonades\") to develop points", "quality": "elaboration and support", "description": "Captures the depth of reasoning achieved through specific examples, quotes, and extended personal observations."}]}
